mapper.insert: INSERT INTO residents (organization_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, synthetic, created_at) VALUES (#{organizationId}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{synthetic}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM residents WHERE resident_id = #{residentId} AND organization_id = #{organizationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM residents WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY last_name, first_name, resident_id

SELECT r.* FROM residents r JOIN resident_locations rl ON rl.resident_id = r.resident_id WHERE rl.location_id = #{locationId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND rl.start_date <= NOW() AND (rl.end_date IS NULL OR rl.end_date > NOW()) ORDER BY r.last_name, r.first_name, r.resident_id
mapper.update: UPDATE residents SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone} WHERE resident_id = #{residentId} AND organization_id = #{organizationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
